meta.title: West Africa, 2013–2016
meta.lede: Ebola virus, Zaire species (the Makona variant). 21,803 reported cases in Guinea, Sierra Leone and Liberia, one drop each, week by week. 1,493 genomes grow the tree as their sampling dates arrive.

sources.name: Nextstrain · ebola
sources.citation: Time-resolved phylogeny of Makona genomes; Dudas et al., Nature 544:309 (2017). Build updated 2019-12-14.

sources.name: ebov/space-time · weekly cases by district
sources.citation: WHO patient database counts (max of confirmed and probable), compiled for Dudas et al. 2017.

transformations: Tree dates (decimal years) converted to days since 30 Dec 2013; tips coloured by sampling country; internal nodes inherit their parent's country when unannotated.
District weekly counts summed to country; trailing empty weeks removed.
Each week's count is replayed as that many onsets spread evenly across the week.
At most 400 tips are drawn at once, thinned evenly over time.
